desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT/defence community is focused on fresh Ukrainian deep strikes hitting a Russian airbase and oil refineries, alongside ISW analysis of Iraqi militia disarmament efforts. The single most important development is confirmation of two Su-34s destroyed at Marinovka airfield.

## MAIN THREADS
### Ukrainian Neptune strike on Marinovka airfield
- [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2116228733808058669) reports Ukraine’s navy destroyed two Su-34 fighter bombers at the Volgograd-region base on 29 Oct.
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2116226771121057867) shares satellite imagery analysed by Avivector confirming the two destroyed Su-34s; a higher-resolution image from CyberBoroshno is also cited.

### Ukrainian strikes on Novokuybyshevsk refinery
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2116227633830862959) posts imagery of the Samara-region facility burning after the latest strike.
- [@Tendar](https://x.com/Tendar/status/2116227492474482704) shares video evidence of multiple strike points across the refinery.

### ISW assessment of Iraqi militia disarmament
- [@TheStudyofWar](https://x.com/TheStudyofWar/status/2116227831898226928) publishes a special report detailing how Iranian-backed militias are subverting Baghdad’s plan while PM al-Zaydi balances US pressure; two follow-up threads expand on integration risks and militia resistance.

### 3rd Assault Brigade drone kill
- [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2116228583106490408) posts video of a Hornet drone with automatic targeting downing a Russian Mi-8 helicopter.

### UAV activity near Iran-Iraq border
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2116228683467751771) reports UAVs over Piranshahr and the Iraqi border in West Azerbaijan.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2116228683467751771) — UAV activity over Piranshahr (unconfirmed).
- [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2116228583106490408) — 3rd Assault Brigade Hornet-drone kill of Mi-8 (unconfirmed).
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2116227633830862959) — refinery strike imagery (unconfirmed beyond single post).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts will watch for follow-on Ukrainian strikes on Russian energy and air assets, any Iraqi government moves on militia integration, and further border UAV activity near Iran.
